description: List the wings of your brain — the top-level areas your knowledge is organised under (e.g. "engineering", "family"). For each wing returns the rooms and halls inside, page count, and last-updated time. Use this to discover the right wing/hall to pass to brain_query.

include_team.description: If true, also count team-scope pages. Default false (personal only).
